notes: Found in a public repository and run by a computer-use agent (batch public-1). Write a declarative distance/contact query against an MD trajectory, compile it through a nine-stage plan that prunes and refines time blocks with conservative AABB bounds, and check the hash-certified result next to a Mol* 3D view of the structure. Data used in the run: example. tree.json is the workflow the agent did and a second agent replayed; run.json says how.
